summary: Clannad entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Clannad

primary.why: The Steam release is the official English PC route with improved visuals and achievements. Console ports are valid reading routes, but PC is easiest to capture and document.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Steam Windows version. Record language, voice/settings, route order, save state, and whether Side Stories or other related releases are being kept separate.

entries.remaster_caveats: Keep CLANNAD Side Stories and other related releases separate from the base visual novel entry.
